commands.name: configure
commands.description: View or update CLI settings (api_base, token)

commands.name: evals compare
commands.description: Compare two eval runs (per-case outcome + score delta) — the A/B surface

commands.name: evals generate
commands.description: Grow a suite's golden corpus by sampling + inverting the provider's index (query inversion + hard negatives), de-duped against the existing corpus; preview by default, --apply appends

commands.name: evals promote
commands.description: Promote reviewed candidate cases into the acceptance recall denominator

commands.name: evals register
commands.description: Register (upsert) an eval suite as JSON, or @path to a JSON file

commands.name: evals run
commands.description: Run an eval suite against its provider and store a tagged run

commands.name: evals runs
commands.description: List a suite's run history (newest first; --tag/--limit filters)

commands.name: evals show
commands.description: Show one eval suite by suite_id

commands.name: evals show-run
commands.description: Show one immutable eval run by run_id

commands.name: evals sweep
commands.description: Overfit-safe two-tier tuning sweep over a suite's provider; stores one tagged run per arm and (with --apply) writes back a statistically-significant, held-out-validated, constraint-satisfying winner

commands.name: evals validate
commands.description: Re-probe reviewed positive labels and classify expect_ids as live, hard, stale, or inconclusive

commands.name: federation status
commands.description: Show each active provider's reachability and whether the classifier/reranker models are available

commands.name: insights insights
commands.description: Aggregate per-query telemetry into federation-health signals (under-utilized providers, zero-result rate, p50/p95 latency)

commands.name: query query
commands.description: Search registered providers and return results grouped by provider
